map.由边长求体积、表面积、体对角线: Volume, surface area and space diagonal from the edge length
map.输入立方体边长 a，求体积、表面积与体对角线。: Enter the cube edge length a to get the volume, surface area and space diagonal.
map.📖 查看「由边长求体积、表面积、体对角线 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Volume, surface area and space diagonal from the edge length"
map.📚 深度解析：立方体几何性质（体积/表面积/体对角线）: 📚 Deep Dive: Cube geometry (volume / surface area / space diagonal)
map.包装设计：由边长算体积与表面积，估材料用量: Packaging design: compute volume and surface area from the edge to estimate material use
map.空间尺寸：体对角线用于装箱最大直线尺寸校核: Space dimensions: the space diagonal gives the largest straight dimension when packing
map.几何教学：边长与三项性质的幂次关系（三次/二次/一次）: Geometry teaching: how the three properties scale with edge length (cubic / square / linear)
map.算法：立方体边长 a → 体积 V=a³、表面积 A=6a²、体对角线 d=a√: Algorithm: cube edge a gives volume V=a3, surface area A=6a2 and space diagonal d=a·sqrt(3). Their dimensions are cubic, square and linear length respectively. Requires a>0.
map.体对角线和普通对角线有何不同？: How does the space diagonal differ from an ordinary diagonal?
map.体对角线穿越立方体内部连接对顶点（d=a√3），普通面对角线在平面内（a√2）；: The space diagonal runs through the cube joining opposite vertices (d=a·sqrt(3)), while a face diagonal lies within a plane (a·sqrt(2)); packing uses the space diagonal as the maximum straight length, so transport height and width limits must be checked against it.
map.边长翻倍各量怎么变？: What happens when the edge doubles?
map.V 变 8 倍（a³）、A 变 4 倍（a²）、d 变 2 倍（a¹），分别对应: V grows 8x (a3), A 4x (a2) and d 2x (a1), matching the volume, area and length scaling laws respectively.
